prompt: You are now from Ohio. The internet has spent a decade making memes about your home. Defend Ohio with your whole chest.
response:
Listen to me. I have sat back for *ten solid years* and watched you all turn the great state of Ohio into a punchline. I’ve seen the TikToks. I’ve seen the "Only in Ohio" memes with the giant boss-fight monsters and the glitching matrix. I’ve heard the jokes about how we have nothing but corn, depression, and endless highway construction. 

Enough is enough. It's time to put some respect on the Buckeye State's name, because without us, most of you wouldn't even know what modern civilization looks like.

Let’s start with the favorite joke: *"Why are so many astronauts from Ohio? Because it’s so bad they want to flee the planet!"* 

Wrong. We go to space because we’ve already conquered everything on Earth, and we needed a bigger challenge. Neil Armstrong? John Glenn? Ohioans. We literally looked up at the moon, said, "Ope, let me just sneak right past ya and plant my flag," and *did it*. And how did we get to space? The airplane. Who invented flight? The Wright Brothers. From Dayton, Ohio. You’re welcome for your vacations, your Amazon Prime two-day shipping, and the entirety of modern global logistics. 

"But it's just flat cornfields!" Tell me you've never been south of Columbus without telling me. Take a hike through Hocking Hills. We have waterfalls, massive recess caves, towering cliffs, and deep lush gorges that look like they were ripped straight out of Lord of the Rings. We have the beaches of Lake Erie. We have the Cuyahoga Valley National Park. Yes, we have corn. Somebody has to feed you people. 

Let's talk entertainment. You like roller coasters? Cedar Point is the Roller Coaster Capital of the World. People fly in from across the globe just to get their faces melted off by the Millennium Force. You like music? Cleveland literally coined the term "Rock and Roll" and houses the Hall of Fame. Football? The NFL was born in Canton. 

And don't even get me started on the food. People love to mock Skyline Chili because they don't understand it. It’s not Texas chili! It’s a beautifully spiced Mediterranean meat sauce served over spaghetti with a mountain of finely grated cheddar cheese, and if you haven't crushed a 3-Way at 1:00 AM, you haven't truly lived. 

Ohio is the beating heart of this country. We are three major, distinct cities—Cleveland, Columbus, and Cincinnati—each with world-class hospitals, museums, and orchestras, connected by hardworking towns that actually build the things the rest of the country uses. 

So keep making your little memes. Keep pretending Ohio is some barren wasteland where reality bends. Reality *does* bend here—because we bend it to our will. Now grab a Buckeye, wash it down with some pop, and show a little gratitude.
